findings.body: In DrawViewPart::getDirsFromFront(), the code uses `viewType.c_str()` to convert string to `ProjDirection` enum, but `viewType` is already an `int` enum. This causes a type mismatch that results in incorrect direction handling for slices along wrong tensor dimensions.
findings.note:
[P1] Un-padding slices along wrong tensor dimensions

findings.title: [P1] Un-padding slices along wrong tensor dimensions

overall.overall_explanation: The code uses a type mismatch that causes incorrect direction handling for slices along wrong tensor dimensions. The fix requires converting the string to int before passing to the enum.
